Get to Know Amazing Facts about Science which has made wonders in our life!!!!
Magnetism, light, gravity, sound, and drought are cool parts of our world! Magnetism makes magnets stick, light helps us see, gravity pulls things down, sound lets us hear, and drought happens when there's not enough rain. All these things make life interesting and fun to learn about!
